content.short: Center provides NFT data and a search engine with APIs for metadata, market information, and ownership details.
content.description: Founded in 2021, Center is an NFT indexer that provides APIs to access NFT metadata, market information, ownership details, and other NFT data for building NFT applications. Center offers a cross-chain suite of NFT APIs that unify data across multiple blockchains, helping developers deploy NFT apps faster and with deeper insights. Center operates as an NFT search engine and has indexed over 395 million NFTs across 13 blockchains as of October 2022.
